title: Memory agreement outside a write set
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $s\subseteq\mathbb Z$ a set of memory addresses, $i$ an instruction, and $m$ a memory assigning a $W$-bit word to each integer address. If the instruction's write location belongs to $s$ according to the condition defining writes in $s$, then applying its memory effect to $m$ leaves $m$ unchanged at every address outside $s$.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction satisfies the condition that it writes in $s$
